[EN] Sprouting Up
[ES] Brotes
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Plant the seedlings carefully.
[ES] Planta los brotes con cuidado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Feels good to do good, doesn't it?
[ES] Se siente bien hacer el bien, ¿no?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Plant faerie saplings in the {@Rgn:47011$$Spore Emitter Zone} in Whitefrost Forest.
[ES] Planta los abetos de las hadas en la {@Rgn:47011$$Zona de emisores de esporas} en el Bosque de la Escarcha Blanca.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You've planted all the faerie saplings.
[ES] Has plantado todos los abetos de las hadas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to {@creature:247#1014$$Lenorele} at {@Rgn:47006$$Field Base Lunacy}.
[ES] Informa a {@creature:247#1014$$Lenorele} en la {@Rgn:47006$$Base de operaciones de Lunacy}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
